card.name: "This" in web page footer notices
card.fires_on: The word "this" (or a nearby word like "via", "of", "contact") in web page boilerplate such as site notes, licensing lines, disclaimers and image credits. It sits right before a noun like blog, program, website, essay or report.

modes.label: This + page noun
modes.description: "This" introduces the site or content being described in a notice, license or disclaimer.
modes.example: Licensing:<< This>> essay is licensed under a Creative Commons license

modes.label: Credit and contact phrases
modes.description: Words in image credits or contact lines, like "via", "of", "contact" and "the".

modes.label: About this site
modes.description: "this" after "About" or "in" before blog, website or program.
modes.example: From around the web About<< this>> blog Get a behind-the-scenes look

card.writes: It pushes toward site-structure words like Program, Resource and Wikimedia, and away from some Chinese and URL-style tokens.
card.plain: It marks the little words in website notices, credits and disclaimers that point to "this page" or "this site".
